outcome: resolution of beta-HCG without cytotoxic therapy
cohort: The study involved a 26-year-old pregnant woman (Gravida 2, Para 1) diagnosed with a hydatidiform mole and eclampsia.
finding: This case highlights that a partial hydatidiform mole can present with severe systemic complications like eclampsia and extremely high beta-HCG levels, which can normalize gradually without cytotoxic therapy after evacuation.
mod_finding: An emergency Sectio parva was performed due to suspected septic complications from the hydatidiform mole and eclampsia.
